hook.name: SuperStrat
hook.description: Skims 2.30% from each swap (2.00% to hook reserves, 0.30% to a protocol fee manager) using BeforeSwapDelta, accumulates fees per pool, and reinvests them into Uniswap v4 LP positions via the PositionManager. Supports multi-pool liquidity management for both ETH and ERC20 pools with owner-controlled pause functionality.
